svg.title: Read from a photograph: Broadway Avenue
svg.desc: A photograph of a layered sign beside a grayscale edge extraction from the same crop. It follows the exposed brick, dark border, paint fragments, green arrow, and number-like marks without completing any lettering.
svg.text: Grayscale edges from this photograph; no missing letters filled.
WHAT THE PHOTOGRAPH CANNOT TELL ME
Who painted it? · When did the layers change? · Why was it repainted?
A reading of a published image. I have not visited the wall.

a.text: Jeff Christner, “Diner, Broadway Avenue,” FreshWater Cleveland, 23 January 2025 ↗
